layout.arrangement: Title centered at top. Slide number '10' in yellow circle top-right. Four main content regions below: truth table top-left, scatter/line plot top-right, neural network diagram bottom-left, decision boundary equation box bottom-right. All content regions have thin red borders.

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates at top in large red serif. Body elements are roughly equal visual weight, each enclosed in red-bordered boxes. Graph and table are upper tier; neural net and equation are lower tier.

visual_elements.description: Truth table with red borders. Headers: X₁, X₂, O/P. Row 1: 0, 0, 0 (cyan cell). Row 2: 0, 1, 0 (cyan cell). Row 3: 1, 0, 0 (cyan cell). Row 4: 1, 1, 1 (green cell).

2D Cartesian plot. Vertical axis with arrow up, tick label '2'. Horizontal axis with arrow right, label 'x₁'. Dark blue descending line (decision boundary). Three cyan circular points: one near origin, one on y-axis at y=2, one on x-axis near x=1. One green circular point above the line near x=1, y=1. Numeric label '1.2' in red near x-axis. Red border around plot area.

Perceptron/neural network diagram. Inputs on left: x₁ with weight -5, x₂ with weight -3, bias 1 with weight 6 (red text). Arrows converge to circle containing Σ (summation). Arrow to rectangular step function with text '>0 => 1' and '<0 => 0'. Arrow to output labeled 'O/P'. Red border around diagram.
Rounded rectangle box with light orange/peach fill and red border containing the equation text.

typography_notes: Title is large, bold, red serif font. Body text is black sans-serif. Subscripts used in X₁, X₂, x₁, x₂. Equation uses italic-style variables. Step function text is small sans-serif.
animation_state: No visible animation; all elements appear static and fully revealed.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0). 2. Add title 'Classification of “AND” Truth Table' centered at top in large bold red serif (#c00000). 3. Add yellow circle with '10' in top-right corner. 4. Top-left: create 4x3 table with red borders, headers X₁, X₂, O/P; fill rows (0,0,0), (0,1,0), (1,0,0) with cyan cell backgrounds (#b0e0e6); fill last row (1,1,1) with green cell background (#90ee90). 5. Top-right: draw plot area with red border; add vertical axis with arrow and tick '2'; add horizontal axis with arrow labeled 'x₁'; draw dark blue descending line; place cyan dots at approx (0,0), (0,2), (1,0); place green dot at approx (1,1); add red label '1.2' near x-axis. 6. Bottom-left: draw red-bordered box containing perceptron diagram: inputs x₁ (-5), x₂ (-3), bias 1 (6 in red) feeding into circle Σ; arrow to step box with '>0 => 1' and '<0 => 0'; arrow to output O/P. 7. Bottom-right: add peach box (#ffe4c4) with red border containing 'd(X) = -5 x₁ - 3 x₂ + 6'.
